text:
Maya Chen: Small design review: users keep assuming Rotate = Revoke because of the full-width red alert in the modal. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rotate-new-flow
Samir Patel: I noticed that too. For metadata-only edits we should not surface danger. Danger should only appear when the user explicitly opts to revoke the old key.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility flag: the big visual alert isn't announced by screen readers today. Add an aria-live region and ensure it gets focus/announcement when the revoke option is toggled.
Kevin Liu: Backend note: we can accept an optional revoke_old boolean on /keys/rotate. Default false. If true, backend will mark old key revoked and return {"old_key_revoked": true}. We can gate via feature flag for a rollout.
Nina Park: Copy suggestion for the checkbox: "Also revoke previous key after rotation (recommended if compromised)". Keep unchecked by default. When checked show inline red hint: "Old key will stop working immediately."
Samir Patel: UX pattern: keep primary CTA neutral unless revoke is checked. If revoke is on, CTA turns destructive and we require a short confirmation modal with clear outage risk text.
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard flow: focus should land on the first form field (name). Tab to the checkbox. If user checks it, move focus to the inline alert (focusable region) so screen readers announce it. Escape should return focus to the originating key row.
Kevin Liu: Safety: require an extra confirm only when revoke=true to avoid accidental service disruption. We'll implement server-side guard that logs intention and requires a confirmed flag for orgs with >X keys.
Maya Chen: Also add a tiny help link next to the checkbox: "When to revoke?" -> opens docs explaining staged rollouts and recommended rotation patterns. Include a short CLI snippet in empty state too.
Samir Patel: Empty state copy: show two runnable examples (curl + node). Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"dev-key","scopes":["inference:generate"]}'
```
Jamie Ortiz: Also fix role checks: users without write scope should not see revoke/rotate actions. Frontend bug currently shows revoke in dropdown for read-only users. Hide destructive actions entirely.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1688: "Rotate modal: revoke opt-in + accessible alerts + empty-state snippets + perms visibility" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1688
Maya Chen: Great. Can design + eng pair on acceptance criteria tomorrow and lock copy so we avoid multiple quick iterations? Thanks! :raised_hands:
